def _handle_web_is_enabled(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.action_service.web_is_enabled_element(params)

def web_is_enabled_element(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._run_web_value(params, op="is_enabled")

def web_dom_action(
    action: str,
    xpath: str = "",
    *,
    element_ref: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    root_ref: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    scope_to_root: bool = False,
    css: str | None = None,
    max_results: int = 0,
    button: str | None = None,
    relation: str | None = None,
    name: str | None = None,
    script: str | None = None,
    xpath_segments: list[str] | None = None,
    path: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    anchor: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    multi: bool = False,
    hostname: str | None = None,
    page_url: str | None = None,
    timeout_ms: int | float = 10_000,
    locator_kind: str | None = None,
    frame_locator: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    shadow_locator: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    target_session_id: str | None = None,
    target_browser: str | None = None,
    target_tab_id: int | None = None,
    text: str = "",
    contains_hotkey: bool | None = None,
    send_key_delay_ms: int | None = None,
    clear: bool = False,
    focus: bool = True,
    mode: str | None = None,
    match: str | None = None,
    items: list[str] | None = None,
    indexes: list[int] | None = None,
    append: bool | None = None,
    multiple: bool | None = None,
    location: str | None = None,
    behavior: str | None = None,
    direction: str | None = None,
    search_up: bool | None = None,
    move_speed: str | None = None,
    target_x: float | None = None,
    target_y: float | None = None,
    index: int | None = None,
    left: int | None = None,
    top: int | None = None,
    keys: str | None = None,
    pt: str | None = None,
    _request: RequestFunc | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    params = _web_dom_params(
        xpath,
        xpath_segments=xpath_segments,
        path=path,
        anchor=anchor,
        multi=bool(multi),
        hostname=hostname,
        page_url=page_url,
        timeout_ms=timeout_ms,
        locator_kind=locator_kind,
        frame_locator=frame_locator,
        shadow_locator=shadow_locator,
        target_session_id=target_session_id,
        target_browser=target_browser,
        target_tab_id=target_tab_id,
        action=action,
        element_ref=element_ref,
        root_ref=root_ref,
        scope_to_root=scope_to_root,
        css=css,
        max_results=max_results,
        button=button,
        relation=relation,
        name=name,
        script=script,
        text=text,
        contains_hotkey=contains_hotkey,
        send_key_delay_ms=send_key_delay_ms,
        clear=bool(clear),
        focus=bool(focus),
        mode=mode,
        match=match,
        items=items,
        indexes=indexes,
        append=append,
        multiple=multiple,
        location=location, behavior=behavior, direction=direction, search_up=search_up,
        move_speed=move_speed, target_x=target_x, target_y=target_y,
        index=index,
        left=left,
        top=top,
        pt=pt,
    )
    if keys is not None:
        params["keys"] = str(keys)
    return _web_dom_request("web.action", params, _request=_request)
